name: Rf Bridge → On Advanced Code Received
description: Similar to [`on_code_received` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/rf_bridge/#rf_bridge-on_code_received), this trigger receives the codes after advanced sniffing is started. To use the code, use a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates/#config-lambda) template, the code and the corresponding protocol and length are available inside that lambda under the variables named `code`, `protocol` and `length`.
